overview: The NLG6X40G-IN is a high-performance, industrial-grade gateway designed to anchor large-scale IoT networks. By integrating a robust 8-channel LoRaWAN concentrator with the proven reliability of the NXP i.MX6 processor, it serves as a sophisticated communication hub that maintains secure and seamless data flow, even in the most demanding environments.

Engineered for superior scalability, it delivers consistent performance as network density increases and supports up to 1000 nodes on a single gateway (depending on the field scenario). It facilitates reliable collection and transmission of sensor data to the cloud with minimal latency and maximum security, and offers range up to 15 km line of sight and over 2 km in dense urban environments.

Built for the field, the gateway accepts a wide 85–528 VAC input with integrated over-voltage protection and 10 kV surge protection, supports 4 hours of battery backup after power failure, offers tamper detection and 32 GB of offline data storage, and is housed in a UV-stabilised polycarbonate IP65 enclosure. LTE and Ethernet are standard; Wi-Fi and GPS are optional.
overview_note: * Node count depends on the field scenario. IP65 is self-certified per the brochure.
